description: Multivallate hillfort, now destroyed. Apparently dated primarily to 100 - 400 CE, though with some Late Iron Age artefacts present. The hillfort summit was made up of a series of enclosures, mostly containing roundhouses and showing domestic activity, but the innermost enclosure had no structures but four Bronze Age barrows. This has led to the suggestion that the inner-most enclosure was considered sacred, and potentially a 'shrine'.
